tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. You must follow the led suit. Trumps rank Spadille (Q of clubs) > Manille (the 7 of trumps) > Basta (Q of spades) > A > K > Q > J > 10 > 9 > 8, the trump queen surviving only when trumps are red. Plain suits run A > K > Q > J > 10 > 9 > 8 > 7.

tutorial.info: German Solo is a four-player trick-taker on a 32-card Skat pack (A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7). Eight cards each, so there is no stock. Three matadors outrank every other trump whatever trumps are: Spadille (Q of clubs), Manille (the 7 of trumps) and Basta (Q of spades). The auction climbs Frage (call an ace you do not hold and that is not of the trump suit; its holder becomes a **hidden partner**; five tricks, stake 2), Solo (five tricks alone, stake 4) and Tout (**all eight tricks** alone, stake 8). If everyone passes, whoever holds Spadille is forced to play a Mussfrage (stake 1). Scoring is zero-sum: on a made contract each defender pays the stake and the declaring side shares it (alone +3×, with a partner one stake each); a failed contract reverses the signs. After the configured number of deals the highest cumulative score wins.
